name: After § 16
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text: 16a. Stresses that the use of national names, designations or symbols in the promotion of agri-food products must reflect their genuine and verifiable geographical origin; underlines that the acquisition of non-preferential origin under EU customs rules, particularly through processing or transformation operations involving products or ingredients originating in other countries, should not, in itself, be sufficient to justify the promotion of a product as originating from a particular Member State; emphasises that mere packaging, marketing or final processing must not be used to create a misleading perception of national origin; calls on the Commission to establish clear and binding criteria for the use of national origin claims within EU agri-food promotion policy, taking into account the actual origin and production of agricultural and processed food products, ensuring the protection of producers and preventing consumers from being misled;
